normalizations.aspect: crop ink; scale longer side to 52 px; preserve aspect; centre
normalizations.stretched: crop ink; independently scale width and height to 52 px; centre

alignment_search.selection: maximum Dice, allowing either member to be transformed

method.chamfer: symmetric mean distance-to-opposite-ink on centred normalized masks, divided by canvas diagonal

larger_sign_coverage.selection: mean of high-coverage component; excludes generic sub-strokes

null.method: permute Parpola labels over mapped renderable ids; cluster sizes preserved

shape_null.method: permute Parpola labels over mapped renderable ids; cluster sizes preserved

allographs.matching: 100 nearest non-group pairs by the two endpoint log-frequencies; target signs excluded
allographs.prediction: allographs should have higher position/neighbour similarity and lower co-occurrence

derivational.matching: 100 nearest non-group pairs by the two endpoint log-frequencies; target signs excluded
derivational.prediction: no interchangeability prediction; modifier may change distribution
